import sys
from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions
from pyspark.context import SparkContext
from awsglue.context import GlueContext
from awsglue.job import Job
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, regexp_replace, to_date
from pyspark.sql.types import IntegerType, DoubleType

args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['JOB_NAME'])
sc = SparkContext()
glueContext = GlueContext(sc)
spark = glueContext.spark_session
job = Job(glueContext)
job.init(args['JOB_NAME'], args)

bucket = "propelnoi-vijay-datalake"

# ---------- Read raw files ----------
properties_path = f"s3://{bucket}/raw/portfolio/properties/"
rent_roll_path = f"s3://{bucket}/raw/portfolio/rent_roll/"
opex_path = f"s3://{bucket}/raw/portfolio/opex/"
maintenance_path = f"s3://{bucket}/raw/portfolio/maintenance/"

properties_out = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/properties/"
rent_roll_out = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/rent_roll/"
opex_out = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/opex/"
maintenance_out = f"s3://{bucket}/processed/portfolio/maintenance/"

properties = spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(properties_path)
rent_roll = spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(rent_roll_path)
opex = spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(opex_path)
maintenance = spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(maintenance_path)

# ---------- Clean properties ----------
properties = (
    properties
    .withColumn("city", regexp_replace(col("city"), "^Washington, D\\.C\\.$", "Washington DC"))
    .withColumn("units", col("units").cast(IntegerType()))
    .withColumn("built_year", col("built_year").cast(IntegerType()))
    .select("property_id", "property_name", "city", "country", "property_type", "units", "built_year")
)

# ---------- Clean rent_roll ----------
rent_roll = (
    rent_roll
    .withColumn("month", to_date(col("month"), "yyyy-MM"))
    .withColumn("rent_income", col("rent_income").cast(DoubleType()))
    .withColumn("occupancy_rate", col("occupancy_rate").cast(DoubleType()))
    .select("property_id", "unit_id", "month", "rent_income", "occupancy_rate")
)

# ---------- Clean opex ----------
opex = (
    opex
    .withColumn("month", to_date(col("month"), "yyyy-MM"))
    .withColumn("operating_expense", col("operating_expense").cast(DoubleType()))
    .select("property_id", "month", "operating_expense")
)

# ---------- Clean maintenance ----------
maintenance = (
    maintenance
    .withColumn("month", to_date(col("month"), "yyyy-MM"))
    .withColumn("repair_cost", col("repair_cost").cast(DoubleType()))
    .withColumn("asset_age", col("asset_age").cast(IntegerType()))
    .select("property_id", "system_type", "month", "repair_cost", "asset_age")
)

# ---------- Write processed parquet ----------
properties.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(properties_out)
rent_roll.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(rent_roll_out)
opex.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(opex_out)
maintenance.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(maintenance_out)

job.commit()
